name: Threat list maker
why: A quick way to rank the likeliest attacks on an app before running the full threat model skill.

name: Write docs a new developer can follow on day one
why: Produces an architecture read and a README with decisions, the same habits as design docs and ADRs.

name: Workflow diagram and change planner
why: Draws a process as a diagram and checks each hand-off, useful for key flows in a design doc.

name: Recoverable agent job queue builder
why: Plans a queue with capped retries, no repeated paid work and lost-job recovery, matching the queue and idempotency rules.

name: Agent database migration planner
why: Plans a schema change with staging checks, release order and recovery steps.

name: Review AWS cost and resilience
why: Weighs AWS savings against resilience, a deeper version of the cost and reliability passes in the architecture review.

name: Review Azure cost and resilience
why: The same cost and resilience review for Azure workloads.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a safe restore test, the evidence behind any recovery target in a design.

name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: Turns an incident timeline into a blameless report and prevention actions that feed the quarterly health check.

name: Monthly tech debt keeper
why: Tracks new debt and ranks small fixes each month, alongside the risks and technical debt section of a design.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Keeps dependencies current, which supports the software supply chain item in the OWASP Top 10:2025.

name: Release manager
why: Go or no-go, rollback plan and live check for each release, the operational side of a design.
